title: ChromaDB
descript: ChromaDB is an open-source embedding database: store vectors with metadata and documents, query by similarity and filter by metadata - the storage layer behind RAG assistants and semantic search. It serves HTTP API v2 on one port, keeps collections in the application data folder, needs no external database, and ships an interactive API console at /docs/.
release_note: 1.5.9-1: remediation of the App Center review (C3/C4/C5/C6/C7/C8/C10/T1/F7/S11). Upgraded from 0.6.3 to ChromaDB 1.5.9 (current upstream release), replacing the unmaintained 0.6.x image that the CVE scan flagged. Adds PRIVACY.md, NOTICE.md and a complete README; anonymized telemetry is off and disclosed; the API console at /docs/ is what App Center opens; the container runs non-root with a read-only root filesystem and no capabilities.
important: Requires DockerEngine (installed automatically if missing). Open http://<NAS-IP>:8141/docs/ for the interactive API console; the API is on the same port (/api/v2, health check /api/v2/heartbeat). There is NO authentication: keep it on your LAN or put TLS and auth in front before exposing it. Collections and indexes stay in DockerAppData/chromadbdocker/data. Upstream telemetry is disabled in this package.

zh-hk.descript: ChromaDB 是一個開源的向量資料庫：保存向量、中繼資料與文件，按相似度檢索並按中繼資料過濾，是 RAG 助手與語義搜尋的存儲層。它在一個端口上提供 HTTP API v2，集合保存在應用資料目錄，無需外部資料庫，並自帶一個可互動的 API 控制台（/docs/）。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine（缺少時應用中心會自動安裝）。瀏覽器打開 http://<NAS-IP>:8141/docs/ 即為可互動的 API 控制台，API 在同一端口（/api/v2，健康檢查 /api/v2/heartbeat）。預設沒有任何鑑權——請只在內網使用，公開到互聯網前加 TLS 與反向代理鑑權。集合與索引保存在 DockerAppData/chromadbdocker/data。本包已關閉上游遙測。
zh-hk.release_note: 1.5.9-1：針對上輪審核意見的整改（C3/C4/C5/C6/C7/C8/C10/T1/F7/S11）。從 0.6.3 升級到 ChromaDB 1.5.9，消除舊鏡像中的高危/嚴重 CVE；新增 PRIVACY.md、NOTICE.md 與完整 README；遙測已關閉並如實披露；應用中心打開的是 /docs/ API 控制台；容器以非 root、唯讀根檔案系統、無 capability 運行。

data_notes: `/data` (mounted from `DockerAppData/chromadbdocker/data`) holds `chroma.sqlite3` (collections, metadata, documents, embeddings) and one sub-directory per HNSW index segment (`<uuid>/*.bin`). Data written by 0.6.x lives in `data/chroma/` and is left untouched by 1.x.
design_notes: **Single container, no wrapper.** 1.x writes its logs to stdout and needs no writable working directory, so the previous entrypoint wrapper is gone; the upstream image runs as-is.
**Hardened runtime.** Non-root `1000:1000`, `read_only` root filesystem, `cap_drop: [ALL]`, `no-new-privileges`, and a tmpfs on `/tmp`.
**HTTP API v2 only.** One port serves `/api/v2/...`, the self-hosted Swagger UI at `/docs/` and the OpenAPI document at `/openapi.json`.
limitations: - No authentication by default; anyone reaching the port can read and write collections.
- ChromaDB is API-first: `/docs/` is an interactive API console, not a management UI.
- The API is plain HTTP; use a TLS reverse proxy for remote access.
- Upgrading a 0.6.x installation: the old store in `data/chroma/` is preserved but not read by 1.x; see the migration section in README.md.
